_comment: Operator-owned MCP server config for the optional AIBA MCP client (Phase 7).
COPY this file to config/mcp_servers.json to ACTUALLY enable it. All servers below
are commented-out patterns (enabled:false) so copying the file is inert until
you flip a server to enabled:true AND list 'mcp_call' (enabled) in permissions.json
AND set AIBA_MCP_ENABLED=true. MCP is OFF by default; do not ship real credentials
or live endpoints in this (or the real) config. Secrets are referenced by env-var
NAME only (via env_names) and resolved from the process environment at launch.

config._comment: Global defaults. enabled_default applies only to servers that omit 'enabled'.

example_stdio.name: Example stdio server (illustrative only - PDF/external tool)
example_stdio.note: Illustration of a local stdio MCP server. Replace command/args with your own. No secrets embedded here.

example_remote.name: Example REMOTE server (illustrative - https only, OFF by default)
_comment: Remote (http) MCP servers require enabled:true here AND AIBA_MCP_REMOTE=true.
The URL must be https and pass AIBA's SSRF/network policy (security-urlguard).
Use a placeholder/nonexistent host; never a live production endpoint.
example_remote.note: Remote transport is disabled by default across AIBA. Illustrative only - do not point at a live endpoint.
